definitions.explanation: Thoroughly secured or tightly controlled, leaving no gaps or vulnerabilities. Commonly describes security measures, guarding, warnings, and protective arrangements.

examples.japanese: {厳重|げんじゅう}な{警備|けいび}が{敷|し}かれた。
examples.english: Tight security was put in place.

examples.japanese: {金庫|きんこ}は{厳重|げんじゅう}に{管理|かんり}されている。
examples.english: The safe is kept under strict security.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}は{厳重|げんじゅう}に{保管|ほかん}し、{外部|がいぶ}に{漏|も}れないようにしている。
examples.english: Personal information is stored under tight security to prevent any leaks.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{厳重|げんじゅう}な{警備|けいび} (tight security)
・{厳重|げんじゅう}{注意|ちゅうい} (stern warning)
・{厳重|げんじゅう}に{保管|ほかん}する (store securely)
・{厳重|げんじゅう}に{管理|かんり}する (manage strictly)

Focuses on thoroughness of security and protection, unlike {厳格|げんかく} (strict regarding people/discipline) or {厳密|げんみつ} (precise, exact). Often appears in news about security operations, police activities, and data protection.
